VOSC osc_internal 0 SIN(0 2.500000000e+0 2.200000000e+2)

VCV n34 0 5.000000000e+0

VMINUS n61 0 -12
.model D_SIGNAL D(Is=2.52e-9 N=1.752 Rs=0.568 Cjo=4e-12)
.model D_RED D(Is=1e-20 N=2 Rs=5 Cjo=10e-12)
.model D_SCHOTTKY D(Is=2e-7 N=1.05 Rs=0.2 Cjo=10e-12 Eg=0.69)
.model Q_NPN NPN(Is=1e-14 Bf=100 Br=1 Vaf=100 Cje=10e-12 Cjc=4e-12 Tf=0.5e-9 Tr=10e-9)
.model Q_PNP PNP(Is=1e-14 Bf=100 Br=1 Vaf=100 Cje=10e-12 Cjc=4e-12 Tf=0.5e-9 Tr=10e-9)

REG eg_internal n35 100
C_C1 n5 0 1.000000000e-7
C_C2 n40 0 1.000000000e-8
C_C3 0 n7 1.000000000e-7
R_R1 n7 n38 1.000000000e+4
R_R2 n38 n5 1.000000000e+4
Rtimer_U1_divider1 n7 n40 5k
Rtimer_U1_divider2 n40 timer_U1_third 5k
Rtimer_U1_divider3 timer_U1_third 0 5k
Btimer_U1_latch timer_U1_state 0 I=(v(timer_U1_state,0)-((!(v(n7,0) >= 4.5 && v(n7,0) <= 16) || v(n7,0) < 0.7 || time < 1u) ? 0 : (v(n5,0) < v(timer_U1_third,0) ? 1 : (v(n5,0) > v(n40,0) ? 0 : (v(timer_U1_state,0) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0)))))/1k
Ctimer_U1_latch timer_U1_state 0 100p
Btimer_U1_out timer_U1_drive 0 V=(v(n7,0) >= 4.5 && v(n7,0) <= 16) ? ((v(timer_U1_state,0) > 0.5) ? v(n7,0)-1.2 : 0.1) : 0
Rtimer_U1_out timer_U1_drive n6 50
Btimer_U1_supply n7 0 I=(v(n7,0) >= 4.5 && v(n7,0) <= 16) ? 0.003+max(0,-i(Btimer_U1_out)) : 0
Btimer_U1_discharge n38 0 I=v(n38,0)/((v(n7,0) >= 4.5 && v(n7,0) <= 16) && !(v(timer_U1_state,0) > 0.5) ? 10 : 1e9)
.options reltol=0.001 abstol=1e-12 vntol=1e-6
.save all
.tran 1.000000000e-5 0.1 0 1.000000000e-5
.end
